Question: Find the Fourier sine series of f(x) = x^2 over the interval (0, 1).

Options: 
A. x^2 \sim_s ^\infty\sum_n=1 {{[{{(- 1)^n+1}} / (n\pi)]}} sinn\pix
B. x^2 \sim_s ^\infty\sum_n=1 {{2 / (n\pi)]}} sinn\pix
C. x^2 \sim_s ^\infty\sum_n=1 {{[{{(- 1)^n}} / (n^3\pi^3)]}} sinn\pix
D. x^2 \sim_s ^\infty\sum_n=1 {{[{{(- 1)^n+1}} / (n\pi)] + [{{4}} / (n^3\pi^3)]}} sinn\pix
E. x^2 \sim_s ^\infty\sum_n=1 {{[{{(- 1)^n}} / (n^2\pi^2)]}} sinn\pix
F. x^2 \sim_s 2 ^\infty\sum_n=1 {{[{{(- 1)^n+1}} / (n\pi)] + [{{2[1 - (- 1)^n]}} / (n^3\pi^3)]}} sinn\pix
G. x^2 \sim_s ^\infty\sum_n=1 {{[{{1}} / (n\pi)] + [{{(- 1)^n+1}} / (n^2\pi^2)]}} sinn\pix
H. x^2 \sim_s 2 ^\infty\sum_n=1 {{1 / (n^2\pi^2)}} sinn\pix
I. x^2 \sim_s 2 ^\infty\sum_n=1 {{[{{(- 1)^n+1}} / (n\pi)] - [{{2[1 - (- 1)^n]}} / (n^3\pi^3)]}} sinn\pix
J. x^2 \sim_s ^\infty\sum_n=1 {{[{{(- 1)^n+1}} / (n^2\pi^2)] - [{{2[1 - (- 1)^n]}} / (n^4\pi^4)]}} sinn\pix

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.

The Fourier cosine series for $f(x) = x$ on $0 < x < c$ is given by $f(x) \sim \frac{a_0}{2} + \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} a_n \cos\left(\frac{n\pi x}{c}\right)$.
Calculating the coefficients yields $a_0 = c$ and $a_n = \frac{2c}{n^2\pi^2}((-1)^n - 1)$, which is zero for even $n$ and $-\frac{4c}{n^2\pi^2}$ for odd $n$.
Substituting these values into the series results in the expression found in Option D, which sums over the odd indices $n = 2k+1$.
